FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to quiz.id

FIELD.NAME: proctor_enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether proctoring is enabled for this quiz

FIELD.NAME: gaze_yaw_threshold
FIELD.COMMENT: Deprecated: superseded by gaze_yaw_left_threshold/gaze_yaw_right_threshold, kept for schema continuity with upgraded installs

FIELD.NAME: gaze_pitch_up_threshold
FIELD.COMMENT: Gaze Pitch Up Threshold — admin-configured ceiling, refined per-student by calibration but never exceeded

FIELD.NAME: gaze_pitch_down_threshold
FIELD.COMMENT: Gaze Pitch Down Threshold — admin-configured ceiling, refined per-student by calibration but never exceeded

FIELD.NAME: gaze_yaw_left_threshold
FIELD.COMMENT: Gaze Yaw Left Threshold — admin-configured ceiling, refined per-student by calibration but never exceeded

FIELD.NAME: gaze_yaw_right_threshold
FIELD.COMMENT: Gaze Yaw Right Threshold — admin-configured ceiling, refined per-student by calibration but never exceeded

FIELD.NAME: voice_detection_enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether continuous-speech detection is enabled for this quiz — separate opt-in from proctor_enabled because it needs its own microphone permission and consent

FIELD.NAME: voice_max_continuous_speech
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds of continuous speech allowed before a talking_detected violation is flagged

TABLE.NAME: quizaccess_proctor_logs
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores face detection results per snapshot

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course ID

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: Quiz ID

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User ID of the student

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: Quiz attempt ID

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: Detection status: match, mismatch, no_face, multiple_faces, phone_detected, looking_away, talking_detected, error, active

FIELD.NAME: confidence
FIELD.COMMENT: Face match distance score (lower = better match)

FIELD.NAME: image_data
FIELD.COMMENT: Base64 encoded snapshot image for review

FIELD.NAME: objects_detected
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated list of prohibited objects detected (e.g. cell phone,book)

FIELD.NAME: gaze_data
FIELD.COMMENT: Gaze tracking data: direction,yaw,pitch (e.g. left,-35.2,5.1)

FIELD.NAME: voice_data
FIELD.COMMENT: Continuous-speech episode: label,duration_seconds,avg_confidence (e.g. talking,8.4,0.82). No audio is stored.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of this log entry

FIELD.NAME: review_status
FIELD.COMMENT: Teacher review outcome for this flag: pending, confirmed, dismissed

FIELD.NAME: reviewed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: User ID of the teacher who last set review_status, null while pending

FIELD.NAME: reviewed_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp review_status was last changed, null while pending
